title: Mask, Sample, Revise: A Revisable CTMC Inference Stack for Guided Discrete Flow Matching Text-to-Speech
abstract: arXiv:2606.13989v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent alignment-free non-autoregressive (NAR) text-to-speech (TTS) models formulate synthesis as a conditional infilling task, bypassing explicit duration predictors and external aligners. When speech is represented with neural codec tokens, the infilling problem becomes discrete, making Discrete Flow Matching (DFM), a Continuous-Time Markov Chain (CTMC) framework for discrete generation, a natural fit. However, inference-time control for stable low-step conditional infilling remains underexplored. We propose Mask, Sample, Revise, an inference-time CTMC stack for alignment-free DFM-TTS. The stack combines predictor-free guidance to strengthen text conditioning, prompt-matched conditional coupling to align the probability path with the acoustic prompt, and SC-ReMask, a schedule-constrained remasking mechanism that introduces token-to-mask transitions so de-masking decisions can be revised. translated_title: 掩码、采样、修正：一种用于引导式离散流匹配文本到语音的可修正CTMC推理栈
translated_abstract: 近期的无对齐非自回归（NAR）文本到语音（TTS）模型将语音合成表述为一个条件填充任务，从而绕开了显式的时长预测器和外部对齐器。当语音以神经编解码器token表示时，填充问题就变成了离散问题，这使得离散流匹配（DFM）——一个用于离散生成的连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）框架——成为天然的选择。然而，用于稳定低步数条件填充的推理时控制仍未被充分探索。我们提出了Mask, Sample, Revise，一个面向无对齐DFM-TTS的推理时CTMC推理栈。该栈结合了三项技术：无预测器引导以强化文本条件控制；提示匹配条件耦合以使概率路径与声学提示对齐；以及SC-ReMask，一种受调度约束的重新掩码机制，它引入了从token到掩码的转换，使得去掩码的决策可以被修正。这些组件均无需事后修……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为Mask, Sample, Revise的推理时CTMC推理栈，通过结合无预测器引导、提示匹配条件耦合以及可修正的重新掩码机制SC-ReMask，实现了可修正、稳定的无对齐离散流匹配文本到语音合成。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Mask, Sample, Revise, an inference-time CTMC stack that combines predictor-free guidance, prompt-matched conditional coupling, and a revisable remasking mechanism (SC-ReMask) to enable stable and revisable alignment-free Discrete Flow Matching text-to-speech synthesis.
